visualCharacteristics.purpose: insight article synopsis panel with read time, clamped summary text with a Read more toggle, and author bylines beside it

contentPattern.structure: row 1: [title, e.g. Synopsis] [read time, e.g. 5 Minute Read]; row 2: summary text; optional row: Read more (turns into the expand toggle); then one row per author: [headshot image] [name (linked to profile) + role]

usage: Top of insight/article pages that list authors (insights directory articles).
reuseGuidance: Use when an article synopsis has author bylines. For the synopsis without authors, event-details renders the same structure; both blocks accept any subset of rows.
